name: Minor Soldier's Syrup
text: Activating a dose of soldier’s syrup requires you to combine it with another consumable potion that takes 1 action to activate. Instead, you can activate the potion within the next hour as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. If you do not activate the potion within 1 hour, the potion spoils inside you, and you become enfeebled 1 for 24 hours.
